title: Acquire cost-conscious shoppers via the Forage App
summary: Cost-conscious shoppers are some of the most valuable in grocery. The Forage App connects you with them right when they're deciding where to shop.
body_markdown:
**Cost-conscious shoppers are some of the most savvy and high-value customers in grocery.**


For example, the 36 million people on SNAP spend more than $336 billion on CPGs every year. They return more frequently than other customers, and they fill bigger baskets.


At the same time, they're hard to reach. The loyalty programs, ad networks, and digital channels that retailers and brands have traditionally relied on weren't built with low-income shoppers in mind.


That's why we built the Forage App. It helps low-income, budget minded shoppers discover savings and earn rewards on everyday purchases, and allows SNAP families to easily check their EBT balance. For retailers and CPG brands, it's a direct line to these shoppers, right at the moment they're deciding where to shop and what to buy.


## How it works for retailers and brands


The Forage App is a free tool that helps families manage their benefits and make their grocery budgets go further. To date:


-


Forage App users show 10-20% higher basket sizes than similar shoppers who don’t use the app


-


Forage App users show 61% higher 75-day lifetime value (LTV) than similar shoppers who don’t use the app


-


Forage has helped SNAP families check their EBT balance more than 5 million times


There are three ways for retailers and brands to partner with the Forage App:


1.


**Premium app placements.** Reach shoppers when they’re ready to buy. From high-visibility banners to full-screen takeovers, premium placements make it easy for families to discover your brand, try your newest products, and make the most of their benefits. We geotarget and personalize placements to optimize engagement.


2.


**Item-level promotions.** Offer discounts or rewards on the everyday essentials low-income families already buy. Any app user who purchases an eligible item earns the reward, no matter how they pay. It’s a simple way to introduce a new product, encourage repeat purchases, or support a seasonal campaign.


3.


**Affiliate partnerships.** Become a featured place to shop in the Forage App. By highlighting an incentive such as a discounted membership or rewards on purchases, you give shoppers a reason to choose your store and keep coming back.


## Connect with cost-conscious shoppers


The Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) is the largest food assistance program in the U.S. Every month, it helps millions of families put food on the table.


-


One in nine Americans (36 million) rely on SNAP to meet their nutritional needs


-


SNAP households spend more than $336 billion on CPGs every year


-


SNAP recipients shop 29% more frequently, and their baskets are 32% larger


Cost-conscious shoppers choose the retailers and brands that show up for them. If you aren't reaching them, then your competitors will.


Interested in partnering with the Forage App? Reach out to your account manager or[contact us to get a demo](https://www.joinforage.com/contact/merchants) .
